newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South Africa serial killer toll rises to 18.
newsitem.headline: South Africa serial killer toll rises to 18.

text.p: Police tracking a serial killer in South Africa's eastern KwaZulu-Natal province said on Friday they had found the bodies of 11 more women in the past week, pushing the number of victims to 18.

Police said the women, who had all been strangled, were between the ages of 20 and 30 years, and were all found in a three kilometre (two mile) radius near the town of Phoenix, near the Indian Ocean port city of Durban.
Special police teams are compiling a psychological profile of the killer and trying to identify the bodies, nearly all of whom were in an advanced state of decomposition.
Only four of the women have been identified, police said.
The serial killer is the second to strike the province in two years. In June, Christopher Zikode, 23, was sentenced to 140 years in jail for raping and then murdering eight women in 1995.
